story: As a policyholder, I can submit a motor insurance claim online so that I don't have to visit a branch.

acceptance_criteria.AC-1: A claim can be submitted only for a policy that is active on the accident date.
acceptance_criteria.AC-2: The accident date cannot be in the future or before the policy start date.
acceptance_criteria.AC-3: A claim amount above Rs 2,00,000 sets the 'surveyor inspection required' flag.
acceptance_criteria.AC-4: At least one photo of the damage must be uploaded before submitting.

prompt_given_to_ai: You are a senior QA engineer. Write test cases for user story CLM-214 and its acceptance criteria. Return raw JSON only: an array of objects with keys id, title, covers (list of AC ids), type (positive | negative | boundary), steps (list of strings), expected (string).
